data.title: 伊卡洛斯 · 云层打开的片刻
data.description: 伊卡洛斯在云层断口上空停住，双翼展开，把身体稳在风里。她低头辨认云下露出的水面，晨光沿着银色胸甲和翼尖滑过。画面从她身后略侧拍，翼下能看见远处一小块蓝。
data.action: 悬停后张开双翼，低头确认云缝下的水面
data.camera: 背侧全身远景，翼尖与云缝同框
data.promptProse: High above a break in the morning clouds, Ikaros hovers on outstretched feathered wings. Silver armor and the edge of her left-eye visor catch the sunlight as she lowers her head toward a glimpse of water. Viewed slightly from behind, the whole figure is held against the opening in the cloud layer.
data.animaCaption: She holds a steady hover with her wings spread above the patch of water visible through the clouds.
